evidence.quote: Saving the price and removing the copy are separate steps. A reader can fetch $20 before the update, pause, then refill $20 after removal. The next cache hit still returns $20. Removal can also fail.

sourceChecks.claim: Repeated reads can benefit from cached copies while important data remains authoritative in the original store.
Cache-aside is application-managed cache lookup, source retrieval and fill; consistency is not guaranteed.
Redis offers memory-triggered eviction, approximate LRU and noeviction write errors.
Independent local caches can disagree; external caches share values and add operating complexity.
Simultaneous misses cause duplicate downstream work; coalescing and capped fallback/load shedding reduce this risk.
